browserContract.chromium: detailed trace, callback, reconciliation, next-frame and updated-surface capture
browserContract.firefox: functional, callback, next-frame and updated-surface capture; no Chromium trace stages
browserContract.webkit: functional, callback, next-frame and updated-surface capture; no Chromium trace stages

workloads.ordinary: 100 visible detailed entities across four layers
workloads.dense: 200 visible entities with effects and overlays
workloads.worldExtent: 10x world extent with the ordinary visible set unchanged
workloads.complexity: 200 256-segment paths, 64 gradients, 32 masks, 100 text runs and 100 symbol uses
workloads.continuous: 60 Hz continuous-coordinate motion with a 30-second measured window
workloads.responsive: desktop, 390x844 touch, 320 CSS-pixel reflow and 400% layout-equivalent zoom

unavailablePolicy: A stage without an engine-supported observation is emitted as unavailable with a reason and is never replaced by an estimate.
